items.title: Solana’s Orca merges with Loopscale in push to finance AI, robotics and defense
items.summary: Orca and Loopscale unite as Formation, targeting financing for AI, energy, robotics and defense.

items.title: OpenAI Says a Secret AI Model Cracked Hundreds of Open Math Problems in One Prompt—Mathematicians Want Receipts
items.summary: OpenAI posted 722 AI-written math manuscripts from an unreleased model, saying most came from a single prompt.

items.title: Circle brings USDC, EURC payments to SAP customers through Tereina
items.summary: The partnership with SAP-backed Tereina will let businesses send and receive Circle’s stablecoins from within the financial software they already use.

items.title: Binance Adds JPMorgan and Eli Lilly bStocks as Margin Collateral
items.summary: Four equity-linked tokens join the collateral lineup, with 50% collateral ratios in Cross Margin and Portfolio Margin and a separate tiered schedule for Portfolio Margin Pro.
